- Documented the CAD deliverable and wired it into the repo structure (`README.md`, `cad/t3-prism/README.md`) and ignore rules (`.gitignore`), plus committed the generated artifacts.

Adds an initial Bayesian-optimization code path under `bo/` using `honegumi` to generate a regenerable Ax/BoTorch scaffold, plus a hand-written “real campaign” script that encodes the project’s tensegrity design variables/objectives and runs end-to-end with a synthetic evaluator.

**Changes:**
- Introduces `bo/generate_scaffold.py` to render a pinned-version honegumi Ax scaffold (`bo/tensegrity_bo.py`) and a smoke-test rendering mode.
- Adds `bo/tensegrity_campaign.py`, a customized multi-objective Ax campaign with the project’s design space + objectives and a dummy evaluator to enable immediate iteration.
- Adds BO-focused README/docs, requirements pins, and pytest smoke tests; updates repo README and `.gitignore` accordingly.

## Pull request overview

This PR pivots the BYU Mentored Research Grant proposal from a multifidelity simulation+experiment approach to an experiment-driven single-fidelity Bayesian optimization approach, while dispersing mentoring language throughout all sections.

- Restructured student projects to emphasize hands-on fabrication/testing accessible to sophomores, with mentoring woven into every section
- Simplified timeline from 13 to 10 rows, updated title/abstract/budget, and regenerated latexdiff PDF
